R4-GOV-01.title: Post-run wrapper modification and restoration
R4-GOV-01.description: Following substantive model execution, scripts/run_nhis_d8_r4_substantive.py was edited at Step 2676 to fix a KeyError on line 633 (attempting to look up 'canonical_hash' instead of 'd6_hash' in r2b_state). Upon detecting that this modified the pre-run file hash (Step 2684), the worker reverted line 633 back to its exact pre-run text at Step 2686 (verified at Step 2688).

R4-GOV-02.title: Unauthorized post-run real-data diagnostic command
R4-GOV-02.description: At Step 2662 in transcript 70436ca6-81ea-4ede-8d79-2153d8eaefeb, after substantive execution had concluded, a diagnostic python command was executed attempting to read data/nhis_splits/train_2022.parquet, val_2023.parquet, and test_2024.parquet via pandas.read_parquet to inspect cohort counts. The command immediately raised FileNotFoundError (code exited with 1) because the path does not exist. Zero parquet bytes or rows were accessed. Subsequently at Step 2736, hashlib.sha256 was run on data/processed/nhis/nhis_2022_2024_features.parquet to verify file hash. No model fitting, retraining, or parameter tuning occurred.

R4-GOV-03.title: Post-hoc manifest and audit reconstruction
R4-GOV-03.description: Because run_nhis_d8_r4_substantive.py aborted at Step 11 due to the KeyError on line 633, the post-run audit artifacts (c1_c2_anchor_recheck.json, engineering_sensitivity_comparison.json, post_run_source_verification.json, environment_manifest.json, and execution_manifest.json) were generated post-hoc using the scratch script complete_r4_post_run_audit.py (executed at Steps 2692 and 2696) using frozen output artifacts.

R4-GOV-04.description: At Step 2525 (2026-09-09T15:59:30Z), scripts/run_nhis_d8_r4_substantive.py was initially launched under run ID 20260909T075934Z_d8r4_substantive.
